meta.title: Escher
meta.coverage_note: Coverage is the honest limit of this page. Of the 107 works listed in the gallery, 36 have a wallpaper group in a freely readable source (EscherMath's, computed ignoring colour), and only 5 have a colour group stated anywhere I could reach. The complete classification, colour groups included, is Schattschneider's Concordance in Visions of Symmetry, Tables 1–3, pp. 328–334, which is not freely readable; nothing here is guessed to fill that gap, so the remaining drawings sit in the “not documented” buckets rather than under an invented group.
meta.rights: Escher's works are in copyright. The M.C. Escher Company B.V. reserves all rights and requires written permission for reproduction; no artwork is reproduced on this page — every entry links to the official gallery instead.
sources: EscherMath (Saint Louis University) — wallpaper groups (37 drawings)
David Bailey, essays on the 137 periodic drawings (Internet Archive) — motif, year, colour count
Schattschneider, Visions of Symmetry (1990), Concordance Tables 1–3, pp. 328–334 — the complete table, not consulted (not freely readable)
